basis: The change extends an existing MarkdownEditor-owned compact table menu and keyboard path without adding a new surface or token.
Acceptance depends on the complete source-editing interaction path, including focus restoration, IME, undo, wide tables, RTL, zoom, and simulated touch input.
The production audit fixture exercises the same ElMarkdownEditor implementation shipped by the package.

in: parser-owned table cell identity and source ranges
row and column insert, delete, move, alignment, paste, format, navigation, and undo
compact light, dark, mobile, RTL, zoom, and wide-table presentation
out: spreadsheet formulas, merged cells, or a second table model
consumer application persistence or route composition
physical touch hardware and external screen-reader sessions
